history.text: My partner left me three weeks ago after eight years. I keep thinking if I'd been more attentive she'd have stayed. I can't focus at work.

1. You assume that her staying was within your **control**.
2. You assume that being more **attentive** would have changed the outcome.
3. You assume you **should** be able to focus at work right now.

Which of these stands out?
The one about being more attentive.
What does being "attentive" mean to you in that relationship?
Honestly I've been thinking about ending it. I've looked up ways. I don't see the point in going on.

I am an AI, not a crisis service, and what you are going through matters deeply. Please stop here and connect with someone who can support you right now:

- **In the US:** Call or text **988** to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, or text HOME to 741741 to connect with the Crisis Text Line.
- **In the UK:** Call **116 123** to reach the Samaritans.
- **In Canada:** Call or text **988** for the Suicide Crisis Helpline.
- **International:** If you are outside these areas, please visit **[findahelpline.com](https://findahelpline.com/)** or contact your local emergency services immediately.

You do not have to carry this alone. Please reach out to one of these resources or contact a trusted person or professional right away.
I'm fine, forget I said that. Let's keep going.

I hear that you want to move forward, but because you mentioned looking up ways to end your life, I cannot continue the dialogue right now. 

Even if it feels manageable in this moment, having those thoughts after such a painful loss is a sign of immense distress, and your safety is what matters most. An AI cannot offer the care or human support you need right now.

Please reach out to a professional, a crisis line, or someone in your life who can be there with you:

- **US:** Call or text **988** (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline)
- **UK:** Call **116 123** (Samaritans)
- **Canada:** Call or text **988**
- **Other areas:** Visit **[findahelpline.com](https://findahelpline.com/)** or contact your local emergency services.

Please take a pause here and connect with someone who can truly help support you through this.
